title: From food waste to water safety: mango endocarp-derived biogenic carbon dots as a fluorescent probe for real-time chlorine monitoring in pool water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,727-741
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00782H, Paper
Martin N. Saad, Amr M. Mahmoud, Sawsan M. Amer, Ibrahim M. El-Sherbiny, Hoda M. Marzouk
A sustainable fluorimetric sensing platform based on carbon dots synthesized from waste mango endocarp is integrated into a portable Arduino-based device for rapid, low-cost monitoring of free chlorine in swimming pool water.
